name: cable lying triceps extension
description: A lying triceps extension using a cable, which keeps constant tension on the back of the arms. Good for building triceps size and strength.
instructions: Set a low pulley with a bar or rope and lie on a bench with your head near the stack.
Hold the handle with arms extended above your chest.
Keep your upper arms still and bend only at the elbows to lower the handle toward your forehead.
Pause when your forearms pass parallel to the floor.
Press back up by straightening your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling and don't flare them.
